title: Atelier Meruru: The Apprentice of Arland

info.about: Atelier Meruru: The Apprentice of Arland is a Japanese role-playing video game developed by Gust Co. Ltd. It was released for PlayStation 3 on June 23, 2011, in Japan. Atelier Meruru is the thirteenth installment in the Atelier series, and it continues the series' emphasis on item creation and synthesis.
